questions.stem: Bei der Prüfung der Aussagen zu dieser Form im vorstehenden Auszug: welche Antwort ergibt sich allein aus dem Text?

options.text: In second position after the subject.
At the very end of the clause after all objects.
options.misconception: places the verb in final position like a subordinate clause

options.text: Immediately before the subject in first position.
Between the article and the noun phrase.
options.misconception: misplaces the verb inside the noun phrase

questions.explanation: In a German main clause the finite verb occupies second position, typically after the subject. Final position belongs to subordinate clauses. Other placements break main-clause word order.

questions.explanation: Separable prefixes split off and move to the clause end in main clauses. Keeping them attached or forcing a participle form is wrong for the present tense.

questions.learningObjective: Identify verb-final order in a subordinate clause

stimulus.body: Der folgende Auszug dient der Überprüfung des Verständnisses dieser Form. « weil der Torwart gut haelt » Von vier Antworten passt allein diejenige, die sich aus dem Text ergibt.

questions.stem: Bei der Prüfung der Aussagen zu dieser Form im vorstehenden Auszug: welche Antwort ergibt sich allein aus dem Text?

answer.exemplar: In a subordinate clause introduced by weil, the finite verb moves to the final position, so haelt appears at the end of the clause rather than in second position.

questions.explanation: Subordinating conjunctions like weil send the finite verb to the end. This contrasts with main-clause second position. The change is triggered by the conjunction.
